settings.heading: Delivery & lead time
settings.intro: Made to order — with an honest window, not ‘ships soon’.
settings.fallback_content:
Lead time

Each mattress is made to order. Current window: see the site setting (typically 6–8 weeks). We confirm your dispatch date before the balance is due.

How dispatch is confirmed

You receive written confirmation with a dispatch window. The remaining balance is requested only after that confirmation.

White-glove scope

Where offered: delivery into the room, unpacking, and setup of the mattress. Packaging removed on request where building rules allow.

Areas served

UAE: mainland delivery on the founding allocation; remote areas confirmed at reservation. UK: fulfilment route confirmed per order.
